stem:
Meena's grandmother adds whole wheat roti, salad and plenty of water to every meal, and tells Meena that these keep the body healthy even though they are not all nutrients.
Why does the body still need roughage and water every day?

options.text: Roughage and water give the body energy like carbohydrates and fats do.
Roughage and water are nutrients that build new body cells.
Roughage helps remove waste from the body and water helps absorb nutrients and remove waste through sweat and urine.
Roughage and water are not needed daily because the body stores them for many months.

teacher.key_rationale: The question tests distinguishing essential non-nutrient components (roughage, water) from nutrients. C correctly states that roughage aids waste removal and water aids nutrient absorption and waste removal via sweat and urine, matching the target rule. A wrongly assigns energy-giving nutrient roles; B wrongly calls them nutrients; D wrongly claims they are unnecessary. Key recalculated: C.
